expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: Item 2 says the search `<div>` "can't be reached with Tab, doesn't respond to Enter or Space, and screen readers don't announce it as a button", and item 5 says the delete button "contains only an icon, so screen readers announce it as just 'button'".

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: Item 8 flags `onPaste={e => e.preventDefault()}`, saying it stops users from pasting into the field, and the Optional (UX) note says "delete fires immediately with no confirmation or undo".

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: Item 1 flags `position: fixed; bottom: 0; height: '100vh'`, notes that on mobile "`100vh` also counts the area behind the browser's address bar", and its fix includes `paddingBottom: 'env(safe-area-inset-bottom)'`.
